dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D reduction in width from the widest mid-thoracic region toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Mature white; uniform high-intensity pixel reflectance across the visible dorsal plane.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of multiple faint, longitudinal, low-contrast linear marks (potential healed rake marks) across the dorsal surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Healed, high-frequency linear epidermal scoring is visible along the dorsal mid-line and lateral flanks.
other_distinctive_markers: The transverse, dark-pigmented crescent of the blowhole is clearly visible at the anterior end of the visible dorsal area.
